title: The Flamingo Lake
text: A salt lake pink with flamingos, thousands upon thousands of them, standing on one leg in the shallows. Their honking fills the air. The water is bitter and no fish live in it, but the shore is crusted thick with white salt.

outcomes.text: Good salt, and it sells well, and the flamingos never stop honking.

options.label: Rest by the water and watch them.

outcomes.text: An afternoon of pink and quiet. For once, nothing is wrong.

options.label: The quickest wades out for a feather.

outcomes.text: A long pink feather, for luck.
The flock rises all at once in a roar of wings, and the salt crust cuts like glass.
